# Engravers Old English — source notes

Bundled file: OPTIEngraversOldEnglish.woff, OPTI/Castcraft edition (regular).
Downloaded on 2026-10-09 from the publicly offered webfont package:
https://webfonts.ffonts.net/OPTIEngraversOldEnglish.font.download

Personal-use listing:
https://fontmeme.com/fonts/engravers-old-english-font/

Used at the owner's explicit request for their personal website. The distributor's webfont installation instructions are preserved alongside this file. The package contains no separate author license; these source notes are not an independent license grant. The original author website is no longer accessible during verification.

This is not the separately sold Bitstream or FontSite edition. No purchase was made. Headings retain the site's bold styling; browsers synthesize the bold weight from the supplied regular face. UnifrakturMaguntia remains a bundled SIL OFL fallback.
